snippet.title: Path of Exile: Mirage Official Trailer
snippet.description:
In Path of Exile: Mirage you will take on a rogue sect of the Faridun as they attempt to sap the energies of minor Djinn for nefarious ends, and help a legendary Maraketh Sekhema put an end to an ancient war once and for all.

Our March expansion introduces a new Challenge League, a variety of new and reworked Skill and Support Gems, significant Endgame changes and a plethora of Quality of Life features.

https://www.pathofexile.com/mirage
